qa_pairs.instruction: What unique driver properties are available in the JMS driver that differ from other NetIQ Identity Manager drivers?
qa_pairs.output: The JMS driver has only two unique property groups: the Driver Configuration properties and the Global Configuration Values (GCV) properties. All other properties such as Named Password, Engine Control Values, and Log Level are common to every driver.

qa_pairs.instruction: How can you view the unique properties for the JMS driver in the NetIQ Identity Manager console?
qa_pairs.output:
To view the unique properties for the JMS driver, open the driver administration area and navigate to the two linked pages mentioned on the JMS driver properties page: 
1. Click the "Driver Configuration" link to see the driver‑specific configuration settings.
2. Click the "Global Configuration Values" link to see the GCV settings that are unique to the JMS driver.

qa_pairs.instruction: Which configuration groups are listed as the only unique properties for the JMS driver?
qa_pairs.output:
The only unique configuration groups for the JMS driver are:
- Driver Configuration
- Global Configuration Values (GCV)
All other configuration groups are shared with all drivers.

qa_pairs.instruction: Summarize the main information presented on the JMS driver properties page.
qa_pairs.output: The JMS driver properties page explains that the JMS driver has just two unique property sets—Driver Configuration and Global Configuration Values. All other driver settings are common across drivers, and links are provided to the detailed Driver Configuration and Global Configuration Values pages.
